# Atlético de Madrid vs Manchester United, Champions League, 13 October 2026: research brief (information up to 7 October 2026)

**Note:** Several search results were published after the 7 October cutoff, including match reports and in-play market pages. I left all of them out. Many sites (Sports Mole, Flashscore, Football Web Pages) refused my fetch requests, so some facts below come only from search snippets.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question settles on the official UEFA result. If that is missing, Flashscore is used, then Sofascore.
- Only the 90 minutes plus stoppage time count. A draw resolves "No".

## 2. Current status
- As of 2026-10-07, the match had not been played and nothing settles the question.
- I found no sign that the game would be postponed.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- About 2026-10-10: Atlético have an away La Liga match at Alavés three days before this game, so squad rotation is possible. [Football Web Pages](https://www.footballwebpages.co.uk/atletico-madrid/fixtures-results)
- 2026-09-28: A column by Andy Mitten describes a "harrowing" start for United, with one win in five Premier League games. Commentary says manager Michael Carrick is under pressure. [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/sport/football/2026/09/28/manchester-united-quiz-bruno-fernandes-champions-league-and-more/)
- 2026-09-20: Atlético beat Real Madrid 2-1 at home. Grimaldo scored a penalty and Jonathan David also scored. Real's Huijsen was sent off. Atlético moved to 16 points and provisional 2nd in La Liga. This comes from one source and I could not cross-check it. [elsalvador.com](https://www.elsalvador.com/?p=1294237)
- 2026-09-16: Atlético beat Osasuna 4-0 at home. [Football Web Pages](https://www.footballwebpages.co.uk/atletico-madrid/fixtures-results)
- 2026-09-13: Atlético won 3-0 at Real Sociedad. [Football Web Pages](https://www.footballwebpages.co.uk/atletico-madrid/fixtures-results)
- 2026-09-09: In Champions League Matchday 1, Atlético lost 2-1 at Liverpool. Llorente scored 17'; Szoboszlai scored 40' and Mac Allister 50'. [Football Web Pages](https://www.footballwebpages.co.uk/match/2026-2027/uefa-champions-league/liverpool/atletico-madrid/591968)
- Champions League Matchday 1: United beat Sabah 4-0. [unitedinfocus](https://www.unitedinfocus.com/news/how-man-utd-compare-with-sabah-based-on-form-from-last-six-matches-ahead-of-champions-league-encounter/)
- 2026-09-05: Atlético lost 3-0 at Athletic Bilbao. [Liverpool FC](https://www.liverpoolfc.com/news/opposition-lowdown-atletico-madrid-0?amp=1)
- 2026-08-01: The two clubs met in a pre-season friendly. I did not find the score. [predscope](https://predscope.com/event/clf-mun-atm-2026-08-01-exact-score)
- A Sports Mole preview calls Atlético "in-form" going into this game. [Sports Mole](https://www.sportsmole.co.uk/football/atletico-madrid/champions-league/preview/atletico-vs-man-utd-prediction-team-news-lineups_606700.html)
- I could not find Atlético's results from late September to 7 October, or injury news for either team.

## 4. Base rates
- Atlético's 2026-27 record that I could confirm: wins over Málaga 2-0, Real Sociedad 3-0, Osasuna 4-0 and Real Madrid 2-1; losses to Athletic 0-3 and Liverpool 1-2. A Sevilla win on 29 August also appears. That is roughly 5 wins in 7, but the list is incomplete. [Football Web Pages](https://www.footballwebpages.co.uk/atletico-madrid/fixtures-results), [FotMob](https://www.fotmob.com/es-419/teams/9906/overview)
- Under Simeone, Atlético are historically strong at home in Europe. As a rough reference, home favourites in the Champions League league phase priced around 45-50% win about that often.
- Head to head: in the 2022 Round of 16 first leg in Madrid, the teams drew 1-1, with Elanga equalising late. Atlético won the tie on aggregate. [Covers](https://covers.com/soccer/atletico-madrid-vs-manchester-united-picks-predictions-february-23-2022)

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket, pre-match snapshot via an aggregator: Atlético 44%, United 32%, draw 25%. Volume was thin, about $121 in 24 hours. [coinstats](https://coinstats.app/prediction-markets/odds/sports/ucl-atm-mnu-2026-10-13/)
- Polymarket, another aggregator snapshot: Atlético 50%, United 26%, draw 24%, on about $39K total volume. The snapshot date is unclear. [predscope](https://predscope.com/event/ucl-atm-mnu-2026-10-13)
- Forebet has a prediction page for the match, but I could not see its pre-match pick. [Forebet](https://www.forebet.com/en/football/matches/atl%C3%A9tico-madrid-manchester-united-2547551)
- I found no Kalshi or Manifold markets and no pre-match bookmaker odds.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- About 2026-10-10: Atlético play away at Alavés in La Liga (fatigue and rotation risk).
- 2026-10-10: United play Tottenham in the Premier League.
- Team news and injury reports, likely in pre-match press conferences on 12 October.
- Market moves once lineups are announced on 13 October.
